{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Comms officer''&mdash;send out a distress signal right now. Tell them&hellip; we're outgunned on Malastare!|[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], to a [[Unidentified clone communications officer|clone communications officer]] during the [[Mission to Malastare (Clone Wars)|Mission]] to [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]|<ref name="Outgunned">{{TCWComicCite|6.20|Outgunned}}</ref>}}
'''Communications officer''' was a title held by beings who operated and controlled communications, often aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Members of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] also held this title, and it was also another name for the [[Vice-Chair of Communications]] in the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]].

During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], [[Tey How/Legends|Tey How]] served as Communications Officer aboard [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] flagship, [[Saak'ak/Legends|''Saak'ak'']].

During the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]] was the Chief Communications Officer, also called the Chief controller, of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], serving in the Rebel command center.

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Bendlar Kovings]] served as a communications and flight deck officer at [[Drop Point: Gelgelar]].<ref name="AJ14">{{JournalCite|14|Special Ops: Drop Points}}</ref>

[[Rannd Delckis]] was a junior communications assistant abord the ''[[Stormwind]]'', and, after his defection from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] to the [[Virgillian Free Alignment]], the Communications Officer aboard the ''[[Flurry]]'' during the [[Virgillian Civil War]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]''</ref>
